query:
CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS manufacturing_documents (
  id VARCHAR(36) PRIMARY KEY,
  formulation_version_id VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  document_type ENUM('sop', 'batch_process', 'process_flow_diagram', 'tech_transfer_package') NOT NULL,
  title VARCHAR(500) NOT NULL,
  batch_size DECIMAL(10, 2),
  batch_unit VARCHAR(50),
  equipment_ids JSON,
  safety_precautions JSON,
  quality_checkpoints JSON,
  generated_content TEXT,
  status ENUM('draft', 'review', 'approved', 'obsolete') DEFAULT 'draft',
  version INT DEFAULT 1,
  created_by VARCHAR(36) NOT NULL,
  created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  approved_by VARCHAR(36),
  approved_at TIMESTAMP NULL
);
